verdict.rationale: Pomelo documents platform-run card program management: card issuance and distribution, design and production, shipping, a dashboard, and a credit core. It also publishes an integration benchmark of 11 days from kickoff to the first real-world transaction on a virtual card. However, the pack never says Pomelo provides BIN sponsorship or holds Visa/Mastercard network membership on the founder's behalf; it only implies a network relationship through brand dispute escalation and Visa/Mastercard tokenization. The 11-day figure is a best-case record measured from project kickoff, not a typical signup-to-first-card timeline. missing for 10: explicit BIN sponsorship / sponsor-bank documentation, explicit network membership handled by the platform, a typical (not record) signup-to-live-card timeline, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can launch a card program without becoming a bank — BIN sponsorship, network membership, and program management are the platform's problem, and the time from signup to first live card is documented
